chapterInfo.content:
27
Wɔntwerɛ mmara no ngu aboɔpono so
1Na Mose ne Israel mpanimfoɔ no hyɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so. 2Na da a mobɛtwa Yordan akɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no soɔ no, fa aboɔ akɛseɛ sisi hɔ, na fa akaadoo sra ho, 3na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu so, da a wobɛtwam akɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no soɔ no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo bɔ no. 4Na mo Yordan twa mu no, momfa aboɔ yi a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nsisi hɔ wɔ Ebal bepɔ so, na fa akaadoo sra ho.
5 # Eks 20.25 Na si hɔ afɔrebukyia ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, aboɔ afɔrebukyia, mma dadeɛ so wɔ so; 6aboɔ amuamu na fa si AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia, na bɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; 7#Deut 12.7 na bɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ di no hɔ, na gye w’ani AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim. 8Na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu aboɔ no so, fa kurukyire mu yie.
9 # Deut 26.18-19 Na Mose ne Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no kasa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa sɛ: Israel, monyɛ aso ntie; ɛnnɛ da yi woayɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ɔman; 10enti tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na di ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so.
Ebal bepɔ so nnome
11Na Mose hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara sɛ: 12#Deut 11.29 Motwa Yordan a, yeinom na ɛnnyina Gerisim bepɔ so nhyira ɔman no: Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Yosef ne Benyamin; 13na yeinom nnyina Ebal bepɔ so nnome: Ruben, Gad, Aser, Sebulon, Dan ne Naftali.
14Na Lewifoɔ mfiri aseɛ mfa nne kɛseɛ nka nkyerɛ Israelfoɔ nyinaa sɛ: 15#Eks 20.23; 34.17 Nnome nka onipa a ɔbɛyɛ ohoni a wɔasene anaa agudeɛ, AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, adwumfoɔ nsa ano adwuma, na ɔde bɛsi kokoam. Na ɔman no nyinaa nnye so sɛ: Amen!
16 # Eks 21.17 Nnome nka deɛ ɔyeyɛ n’agya ne ne na! Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
17 # Deut 19.14 Nnome nka deɛ ɔtwe ne yɔnko hyeɛ. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
18 # Lew 19.14 Nnome nka deɛ ɔma onifirani fom kwan. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
19 # Eks 22.21-22 Nnome nka deɛ ɔkyea ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ atemmuo. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
20 # Lew 18.8 Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’agya yere da, ɛfiri sɛ wayi n’agya nkataho. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
21 # Eks 22.19 Nnome nka deɛ ɔne aboa biara da. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
22 # Lew 18.9, 11 Nnome nka deɛ ɔne ne nuabaa, n’agya ba anaa ne na ba da. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
23 # Lew 18.15, 17 Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’ase da. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
24 # Num 35.20 Nnome nka deɛ ɔhunta de adeɛ bɔ ne yɔnko. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
25 # Deut 16.19; Eks 23.8 Nnome nka deɛ ɔgye apaadeɛ sɛ ɔbɛkum onipa a ɔdi bem. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
26 # Gal 3.10 Nnome nka deɛ ɔmfa mmara yi mu nsɛm nsi hɔ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!

Na Mose ne Israel mpanimfoɔ no hyɛɛ ɔman no sɛ: Monni mmara nsɛm a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nyinaa so. Na da a mobɛtwa Yordan akɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no soɔ no, fa aboɔ akɛseɛ sisi hɔ, na fa akaadoo sra ho, na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu so, da a wobɛtwam akɔ asase a AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn de rema woɔ no soɔ no, asase a nufosuo ne ɛwoɔ sene wɔ soɔ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo nananom Nyankopɔn ahyɛ wo bɔ no. Na mo Yordan twa mu no, momfa aboɔ yi a merehyɛ mo nnɛ yi nsisi hɔ wɔ Ebal bepɔ so, na fa akaadoo sra ho.
Na si hɔ afɔrebukyia ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, aboɔ afɔrebukyia, mma dadeɛ so wɔ so; aboɔ amuamu na fa si AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn afɔrebukyia, na bɔ so ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ma AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn; na bɔ asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ di no hɔ, na gye w’ani AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn anim. Na twerɛ mmara yi mu nsɛm nyinaa gu aboɔ no so, fa kurukyire mu yie.
Na Mose ne Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no kasa kyerɛɛ Israel nyinaa sɛ: Israel, monyɛ aso ntie; ɛnnɛ da yi woayɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ɔman; enti tie AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn nne, na di ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi so.

Na Mose hyɛɛ ɔman no da no ara sɛ: Motwa Yordan a, yeinom na ɛnnyina Gerisim bepɔ so nhyira ɔman no: Simeon, Lewi, Yuda, Isakar, Yosef ne Benyamin; na yeinom nnyina Ebal bepɔ so nnome: Ruben, Gad, Aser, Sebulon, Dan ne Naftali.

Nnome nka deɛ ɔyeyɛ n’agya ne ne na! Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!

Nnome nka deɛ ɔma onifirani fom kwan. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔkyea ɔhɔhoɔ, awisiaa ne okunafoɔ atemmuo. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’agya yere da, ɛfiri sɛ wayi n’agya nkataho. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne aboa biara da. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne ne nuabaa, n’agya ba anaa ne na ba da. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔne n’ase da. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔhunta de adeɛ bɔ ne yɔnko. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔgye apaadeɛ sɛ ɔbɛkum onipa a ɔdi bem. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!
Nnome nka deɛ ɔmfa mmara yi mu nsɛm nsi hɔ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ. Na ɔman no nyinaa nka sɛ: Amen!

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
